main_text.l: Siquidem quæ ab ipso facta essent sancta
vtique & pia, atque omni ex parte
lut in caufis etiam criminosorum fieri
consueuit, sed clamore vulgi fidelcs de-
lati, tanquam de crimine conuicti neci
dabantur, vt apparet ex literis Sereniy
fuerat amplexata; omnes, qui in ea e-
adiere, palàm se Christianos esse profi-
tentes, eaque de causa omnes se liben-
ter mortem oppetituros. Cum is rei
paucis ex illis damnatis, in reliquos vt

page.notes: Printing errors left as printed: "fidelcs" (for fideles), "temporibns" (for temporibus), "sancta" read as sancta. "Sereniy" is doubtful: the italic word after "literis" may be "Serenissimi" or a similar form, so the reading is uncertain. The word "Cum" after "oppetituros." is read as printed, with an accent that may be a grave mark. The reference mark "*" in the text is matched to the marginal note "Tertul. ad Scapulam vlt.".
